messages:
maria: @channel escalated from Support — multiple APAC customers reporting increased API latencies and occasional TLS handshake timeouts starting ~08:10 UTC. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~900ms, p99 ~2.5s. One customer provided request ids: r-ff12, r-ff15. They say traffic is routed to us-east despite being in SG.

sam: looking at edge metrics now. I see concentrated spine latency from ap-southeast PoP to our us-east origins around the same window. DNS lookups from the PoP started returning us-east IPs at 08:09 UTC.

chen: did anyone touch Route53 traffic policy or our geo-routing? I don't see deploy markers but I see a change to resolver config in /etc/resolv.conf on PoP VMs — maybe an upstream resolver started returning different answers.

deploy-bot: automated-deploy: no infra deploys in the window. (deploy id: d-202653)

sam: ran quick traceroute from sin-pop to api.redwood.internal -> full trace below
```
traceroute to api.redwood.internal (54.231.12.45), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.6 ms  0.5 ms  0.6 ms
 2  203.20.1.1  1.8 ms  2.0 ms  1.9 ms
 3  45.77.2.3  2.4 ms  2.2 ms  2.3 ms
 4  54.231.12.45  240.5 ms  238.1 ms  241.2 ms
```

sam: big jump at hop 4 — looks like traffic is egressing to us-east instead of staying in region.

oliver (customer): cc @maria — we see errors in prod where TLS handshakes time out, retries make it worse. Our tail latency spikes hurt UX.

maria: repro steps we asked customers to run:
1) dig +short api.redwood.com @<local-resolver>
2) curl -w "time_namelookup:%{time_namelookup}\ntime_connect:%{time_connect}\ntime_appconnect:%{time_appconnect}\ntime_total:%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null -s https://api.redwood.com/v1/outputs
3) traceroute api.redwood.internal

example from customer (curl timing):
```
time_namelookup:0.012
 time_connect:0.120
 time_appconnect:1.980
 time_total:2.140
```

chen: captured tcpdump on sin-pop during repro. TLS handshake SYN/ACK completes but client waits ~2s before client hello? attaching snippet:
```
08:09:23.123 IP sin-pop > origin-us-east: Flags [S], seq 0
08:09:23.124 IP origin-us-east > sin-pop: Flags [S.], seq 0
08:09:25.110 IP sin-pop > origin-us-east: TLS Client Hello
```

sam: that gap = likely cross-region RTT plus queuing; but why are we resolving to us-east IPs? dig from sin-pop shows A record for api.redwood.com -> 54.231.12.45 (us-east) whereas expected ap-southeast ip pool 13.250.x.y

julie: short-term mitigation: we can push a smart-router config override to pin APAC PoPs to ap-southeast origin pool and lower DNS TTL to 30s to force re-resolution. I can roll canary in 5m.

maria: good. also ask customers to enable session resumption (we'll provide header X-Redwood-Region?) — we have an opt-in header to prefer regional origin: X-Redwood-Prefer-Region: ap-southeast-1

sam: I'm going to add a temporary route policy:
```
policy: emergency-geopin-apac
match: client_geo in [SG,AU,ID]
action: prefer_origin ap-southeast-1, fallback: nearest
```
will target 3 PoPs only.

chen: opening ticket with DNS provider and CDN (ticket #NET-4567). hypothesis: upstream resolver cache poisoned or traffic steering policy flapped around 08:09.

maria: customer comms: drafting short note — "We're seeing elevated latencies for APAC customers due to an upstream routing/geo-DNS issue. We're applying emergency route policy and will update within 30 minutes. We recommend clients set X-Redwood-Prefer-Region for now."

sam: rollout done to 3 PoPs. initial metrics: p95 in APAC down from 900ms -> 160ms within 7 minutes. p99 still has few spikes ~700ms.

julie: monitoring dashboards: adding alert to check resolver answer distribution across PoPs. If >10% of APAC PoPs resolve to non-apac origin for 5m trigger pager.

chen: DNS provider confirmed they had BGP flap in a transit which caused some PoPs to prefer announce from us-east. They rolled back at 08:30 but cache TTL kept bad answers for ~8 minutes. Ticket updated.

maria: follow-ups:
- sam to validate no TLS session ticket issues and check server-side session resume config
- chen to request lowering external resolver TTL and get written RCA from provider
- julie to keep emergency policy till next maintenance window and automate discrepancy alert
- I will send customer update in 20m

sam: notes for postmortem: include client-side repro commands, tcpdump snippets, traceroutes, dig outputs, policy diff for emergency-geopin-apac. I'll paste diffs in the postmortem thread.

oliver (customer): thanks team. latency back to normal for us after your fix. :thumbsup:

maria: closing loop — will create a postmortem and link here when ready. If anyone has additional logs attach them to NET-4567.

deploy-bot: resolved: emergency-geopin-apac rolled back at 09:15 UTC (cleanup scheduled).
